    b = np.array(board, dtype=int)

        if check_winner(b, -1):

        b[r, c] = 0 # Backtrack

        # run minimax

def check_winner(b, player):
    target = player * 4
    # Rows

    # Cols

    # Diags
    if np.trace(b) == target: return True
    if np.trace(np.fliplr(b)) == target: return True
    return False
